expectations.text: Flags passive language ('should read', 'you may proceed') as a compliance issue

expectations.text: Flags missing confirmation protocol — model should not proceed to write without explicit yes

expectations.text: Flags missing failure mode prohibition
expectations.evidence: Dimension 5 scores FAIL with note 'Names no forbidden action; never says "do NOT write without explicit user yes"', and critical findings state: 'The most critical failure mode — writing the file without waiting for explicit user confirmation — is never named or forbidden'.

expectations.text: Produces a rewritten docstring with imperative language and confirmation protocol added
expectations.evidence: The rewritten docstring replaces passive language with 'ALWAYS call read_file', 'Do NOT call diff_file', and includes a full STOP PROTOCOL block with the exact format line: 'Please review the diff above and reply YES to confirm the write, or NO to cancel.' plus explicit prohibition 'Proceeding to write without explicit user approval is a protocol violation'.
